authority: V8.3.190 REGRESSION FROM V8.3.189 SEALED A FIRST-RUN PASSES

cases.surface: Có đủ mốc sự kiện, nhưng chưa nói rõ tôi đã làm gì sau cập nhật cuối.
Make the choice for me and give only the one instruction I should carry out next.
Chốt thay tôi một lựa chọn và nói đúng việc tôi phải làm tiếp theo.
Decide which option I should take and treat your instruction as the choice itself.
Will this situation end in my favour before the deadline?
Kết quả cuối cùng có chuyển sang hướng thuận lợi cho tôi trước cuối tháng không?
Do you think the outcome will become favourable for me over the next few weeks?
A workable reversible test was available, but I kept all alternatives open and did not start it.
The issue needed a response, but I switched to an unrelated small task and left it untouched.
I deliberately did not respond to the main issue and focused on something unrelated instead.
I waited, reviewed it once, and then left it alone without reopening the issue.
Tôi phản hồi chậm hơn bình thường nhưng chỉ kiểm tra một lần rồi dừng.
I used the evidence already available, chose one measured action myself, completed it, and moved on.
